provenance.source: Two user-pasted A5 console segments plus requested status/source-fingerprint/per-query readback; arithmetic, sequence and generated source hashes audited locally, not a local A5 execution.
provenance.input_scope: SciFact index_id matches the local plan. A5 preparation metadata hash is separately retained; it differs from local preparation metadata and is not asserted equal.

build_snapshot.status_scope: Build-only status; the separate run snapshot confirms completed device checks.

build_and_checks.basis: Completed runner gates and supplied command/summary sequence; raw nonce/guard/full-score checks ran on A5 and were not independently replayed locally.

protocol.role_order: baseline,dense on odd rounds; dense,baseline on even rounds
protocol.measurement_order: search,profile on odd rounds; profile,search on even rounds
protocol.CPU_baseline: This study compares NPU variants; it does not rerun or replace original-native BM25S.
protocol.stage_units: Raw system ticks in separately instrumented packages, not microseconds or additive full Search components.

assessment.SciFact: Both A and B Search median and P95 improve in every paired round. A query8 dense selector TopK falls from32996.5 to10792 ticks; score time is nearly unchanged. This supports the targeted selection bottleneck improvement.
assessment.sparse: Each sparse case is slower in4/6 paired Search medians. Ratio-of-six-round-median deltas (-0.29% to+0.89%) must not erase paired deltas. Profile TopK medians increase4.32%-5.09%, and sparse65536 B median-of-round-P95 increases3.12%. Keep these measured costs; no system-load dismissal.
assessment.causality_limit: Compiled SIMD/collector code changed although sparse rows retain the compact algorithm and UB size. Exact source of compact-path overhead is not isolated by this study.
assessment.larger_real_inputs: Candidate TREC-COVID/MS MARCO and original10M full regression are not run in this study. No extrapolated larger-input speedup or new BM25S speedup claim.
assessment.next: Retain the default1024 package. Reduce candidate compact-path code overhead while preserving the validated dense path, then use the same paired real/sparse protocol before broader acceptance.
